title: The Click Before the Arterial
scene: Fog at midday on the last Kent mill, cones ending, the collector about to become somebody else's problem. You reach for the shifter and the belt is not there. It was, this morning. It is not now. The Ejection is not a creature. It is a statistic with a buckle. The Grid is done if you roll onto the bigger road unclipped. Deac would not start a log line without it. The Menace's cheap aftermarket belt is a pain in the mesh. That is not a reason. The fog would hide a short slide. The belt is the difference between a slide and an ending. You can hear the shelter radio from here. You cannot hear a second chance.
decision: The belt is off and the mill is ending. What happens before you take the next street?

options.text: Go — you will clip it at the next stop, and the fog is already eating time
options.result: You do not get a next stop. A volunteer comes out of the fog already braking. You dump yours. The cheap belt that was not on does not hold. The game does not show the rest. It does not have to.

options.text: Clip it at rolling speed so you do not lose the gap
options.result: One hand off, eyes in your lap, mill lip under the tires. You miss the latch. The volunteer is already in your fog. You correct the wheel late. A belt in the hand is not a belt in the latch.

options.text: Stop fully off the mill, clip, tug the belt, then take the next street
options.result: You refuse the last-second. Gravel. Click. Tug. The aftermarket latch takes. You roll out of the fog with a belt on and a Grid behind you. The Arterial can be someone else's act. You still have a body in the seat to hand it to.

options.text: Loop it over your shoulder without the latch so at least it looks done
options.result: The sash does no work when the first hard brake arrives. The webbing slides through. You are out of the seat the cheap belt was supposed to keep. The latch was the whole point.

debrief: Belt on, latched, tugged, before the vehicle moves. Not at the next stop. Not over the shoulder. The Grid ends on that click.

source.teaching_target: Fasten and tug the seat belt before moving; a belt over the shoulder that is not latched is not a belt.

image_brief.subject: inside the Pink Menace cabin from the right-hand seat, looking across at the empty seat on the left
image_brief.foreground: unlatched aftermarket seat belt hanging slack down the door pillar, metal tongue on the seat cushion
image_brief.midground: empty left seat, cracked faded pink door card, riveted raw steel, steering wheel on the left; nobody in frame
image_brief.background: through the window, a wet empty residential block under flat gray overcast, out of focus
image_brief.read: the belt is visibly unlatched and hanging loose beside an empty seat
